paras: Refresh your Honda Civic Type R FK8 or FL5 's factory two-piece front brake rotors with DIXCEL FS replacement rotor rings, engineered in Japan and developed through decades of OEM supply and motorsport experience. DIXCEL rotor rings are designed to deliver consistent braking performance, stable pedal feel, and reliable control under demanding street and circuit conditions, while preserving the aluminium centre hats, mounting bobbins, and hardware from your factory Civic Type R Brembo brake setup.

This listing covers a matched left and right pair of 350x32mm DIXCEL FS replacement front friction rings for the Honda Civic Type R FK8 (2017 - 2021) and FL5 (2022 onwards). These rings are designed as direct replacements for the factory Brembo front rotor friction rings, preserving your factory aluminium centre hats and mounting hardware. The ring-only design provides significant cost savings over a complete rotor assembly replacement when only the friction ring is consumed.
